import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess,sys
r=json.loads(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes());root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
def h(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
checks=0
for p in r["base_absence"]:
 assert subprocess.check_output(["git","ls-tree","--name-only",p["base_commit"],"--",p["path"]])==b"";checks+=1
for p in r["whole_provider_pins"]:
 b=subprocess.check_output(["git","show",p["commit"]+":"+p["path"]]);assert len(b)==p["git_bytes"] and h(b)==p["git_sha256"];checks+=1
for p in r["provider_regions"]:
 b=subprocess.check_output(["git","show",p["commit"]+":"+p["path"]]);q=b"".join(b.splitlines(keepends=True)[p["first_line"]-1:p["last_line"]]);assert len(q)==p["bytes"] and h(q)==p["sha256"];checks+=1
for p in r["new_source_pins"]:
 b=(root/p["path"]).read_bytes();assert len(b)==p["bytes"] and h(b)==p["sha256"] and b==pathlib.Path(p["frozen_path"]).read_bytes();checks+=1
p=r["design_proposal"];b=pathlib.Path(p["frozen_path"]).read_bytes();assert len(b)==p["bytes"] and h(b)==p["sha256"];checks+=1
pe=pathlib.Path(r["pe"]["path"]).read_bytes();assert h(pe)==r["pe"]["sha256"];checks+=1
n=r["native"];b=bytes.fromhex(n["hex"]);assert len(b)==205 and h(b)==n["sha256"] and pe[n["pe_file_offset"]:n["pe_file_offset"]+205]==b;checks+=1
p=r["unreachable_padding"];q=bytes.fromhex(p["hex"]);assert len(q)==6 and h(q)==p["sha256"] and pe[p["pe_file_offset"]:p["pe_file_offset"]+6]==q;checks+=1
z=bytearray(205);covered=set()
for o in n["instructions"]:
 a=int(o["address"],16)-int(n["entry"],16);q=bytes.fromhex(o["bytes_hex"]);z[a:a+len(q)]=q;covered.update(range(a,a+len(q)))
a=int(p["entry"],16)-int(n["entry"],16);z[a:a+6]=bytes.fromhex(p["hex"]);covered.update(range(a,a+6));assert bytes(z)==b and len(covered)==205 and len(n["instructions"])==74;checks+=1
for p in n["exports"]:
 q=pathlib.Path(p["frozen_path"]).read_bytes();assert len(q)==p["bytes"] and h(q)==p["sha256"];checks+=1
s=(root/r["new_source_pins"][1]["path"]).read_text();ps=[s.index(x["needle"]) for x in r["source_order"]];assert ps==sorted(ps);checks+=1
p=r["document_pin"];b=(root/p["path"]).read_bytes();assert len(b)==p["bytes"] and h(b)==p["sha256"];checks+=1
assert r["compiled"] is False and r["credit"]["native_origin"] is False
print(json.dumps({"pass":True,"checks":checks,"native_ops":74,"padding_bytes":6,"native_calls":4,"source_order_pins":len(r["source_order"]),"providers":len(r["whole_provider_pins"]),"regions":len(r["provider_regions"])}))
